notes: Analyze-then-promote: the backend ranks Pinterest/X/LinkedIn by product fit, publishes to Pinterest + LinkedIn via their free APIs, and returns an X draft (X API is pay-per-use since Feb 2026 — manual posting only). Needs BACKEND_URL, N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET, and backend env for the platforms (PINTEREST_ACCESS_TOKEN/BOARD_ID, LINKEDIN_ACCESS_TOKEN/AUTHOR_URN).
